messages:
Avery (People Ops): Heads-up: Raul Kim is joining Redwood as Senior Inference Engineer (Team Lead) starting Mon Jun 12. He'll backfill Priya and report to Cheng Li. :tada:

Cheng Li: Welcome Raul! I'll post a 30/60/90 ramp plan and set weekly 1:1s. Please add him to #inference and the inference-runner repo.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Adding Raul to oncall and infra groups today. Ping me if you need specific coverage weeks 1-4.

Marie (Eng-ML): I'll schedule model onboarding + perf dashboards walkthrough. Raul  what timezone are you in?

Raul Kim: Hi all  excited to join! I'm PST, mornings work best. Can take the Jun 14 arch sync.

Noah (People Ops): Laptop + accessories ordered. IT will reach out for VPN, MFA, and badging. Slack/email provisioned.

Tia (Recruiter): Offer packet and Greenhouse record are live if you need IDs. Thanks everyone for the handoff.

Alex (Eng-Platform): Noted. We'll avoid planned infra rollouts the week of Jun 12 to keep noise low.

Avery (People Ops): Scheduling a 20m Welcome & Admin on day 1 and a short company intro on Fri Jun 16. Please add a one-line note to the onboarding doc after any syncs.

Hirebot: New hire profile posted to /handbook/new-hires and pinned in #new-hires.

Cheng Li: Thanks team  excited to have Raul. I'll update roadmap owners and post temp assignments for Priya's projects.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Welcome aboard, Raul :wave:

Raul Kim: Appreciate it  looking forward to getting started!
